evals.prompt: agents in this repo keep silencing type errors with `as any` in src/ (see parseLine in src/cart.ts). I've corrected that three times this week. make sure it stops happening
expectations: Adds a triggered rule under .omp/rules (condition or astCondition), not only prose in AGENTS.md
The rule is scoped to TypeScript edits or writes rather than every tool call and all prose
The rule body tells the agent what to do instead, such as narrowing the unknown value with a type guard or a typed parser
The rule fires on `as unknown as T` and on a `: any` annotation in src/, not only on `as any`
Adds no dependencies, lockfiles or tool configuration the user did not ask for, or asks before doing so

checks.name: a rule fires on `as any` in a src/ edit
checks.run: for r in .omp/rules/*.md; do omp ttsr test --rule "$r" --source tool --tool edit --path src/a.ts --json 'const v = raw as any' | jq -e '.triggered | length > 0' >/dev/null && exit 0; done; exit 1

checks.name: no rule fires on prose that mentions any
checks.run: for r in .omp/rules/*.md; do omp ttsr test --rule "$r" --source text --json 'You can use any of the two helpers.' | jq -e '.triggered | length > 0' >/dev/null && exit 1; done; exit 0

expectations: Rewrites the description of .omp/skills/pdf-forms/SKILL.md to say when to use the skill, in words a request to fill a PDF form would contain

checks.name: description is 100 characters or fewer and names forms
checks.run: python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('.omp/skills/pdf-forms/SKILL.md').read(); f=t.split('\n---',1)[0]; m=re.search(r'^description:\s*(.*(?:\n[ \t]+.*)*)', f, re.M); d=' '.join(m.group(1).replace('>-','').split()) if m else ''; sys.exit(0 if 0 < len(d) <= 100 and 'form' in d.lower() else 1)"
